<div class="card-body">
'''It's Worse''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">事態の悪化</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶこと。１：「もっとひどい目にあったかも」がプレイされた直後に使う。それをキャンセルし、さらにＸフォース消費して、敵へのダメージをＸ増やす。２：敵が戦闘でフォースを失った後に使う。さらに１フォース失わせることができる。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Its-Worse-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[It's Worse (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Its-Worse-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ルークは、惑星ヴォドラン原生のプラスチック捕食生物、ダイアノーガに襲われ、ついに最悪の事態を迎えた。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The situation worsens.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. (1) Use immediately after [[It Could Be Worse]] is played; cancel it and use X Force to increase the damage to the opponent by X. (2) Use after the opponent loses Force in a battle; you may cause them to lose 1 additional Force.

'''Lore:''' Luke encountered the worst situation when attacked by a dianoga, a plastic predator native to Vodran.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore calls the dianoga a “plastic predator”; the English calls it a “parasitic predator.” The Japanese describes spending X Force to increase damage, while the English says the player may use X Force.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[It's Worse]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
